what: Larger wrist test did not start after robot cameras dropped off USB; both arm adapters subsequently disappeared too.
why: Further physical control needs current camera/encoder feedback and resolved coordinate references.
details: Operator asked to restore USB connections. Both shoulders, left elbow and both grippers had out-of-nominal readings; no re-zero or limit widening. Stationary velocity reports also varied while encoder positions were nearly constant. Wrist-camera serial-to-arm assignment, camera/base calibration and whole-arm stop behavior remain unverified.
